text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-05, a flaky CI job in build/ci/pipeline.yml affecting v1 SDK clients was fixed.","The root cause of the flaky job was connection pool exhaustion under burst load.","The fix raised the connection pool ceiling and added a bounded wait queue, implemented in PR #1576 on branch fix/flaky-job-1.","The fix improved cold start performance by 77%, reducing it to 286 milliseconds.","The flaky CI job was reproducible by rerunning the same commit ten times."]}
